physics.units: m, s; pressure is p/rho in m2/s2
physics.originalBoundaryModel: Constant speed .5 in each inner facet tangent; stationary outer polygon. Adjacent actual facet tangents jump; this is not the exact circular Couette boundary model.
physics.start: zero velocity/pressure for cold runs; hybrid native SIMPLE resumes its own final iterate after 1500 steps
physics.nativeControls: strict 1e-8, upwind, symmetric viscous stress, SIMPLE .6/.25, four pressure corrections; unchanged original solver gates
physics.comparisonLimits: External solvers use their own residual definitions and boundary/discretization closures. Iteration counts do not compare speed or physical accuracy.

gridSources.geos: GEOS3.14.1 via Shapely2.2.0 independently cuts same original polygon; native topology/agglomeration/quality repair remain shared. Not a complete independent mesher.
gridSources.hybrid: Product inner-cylinder 3-row hybrid (768 retained cells), then declared GEOS outer-polygon crop and constrained native topology. Research adapter; product nested-loop H4 still rejects annulus.
gridSources.cfmesh: foam-extend cartesian2DMesh end-to-end independent mesher, high-precision same source CAD, no native post-repair. Its fitted wall differs by .0001505793m; separate geometry-approximation reference, not strict matched pure Cut-cell.

errors: Area-weighted cell-centre RMS; remove optimal weighted pressure constant. Pressure RMS and maximum divided by analytic inner-outer pressure span, not by an arbitrary gauge or called pressure-drop error. Original facet-wall deviations include geometry/boundary-model and numerical errors.

validation.externalMeshChecks: Standard and extended reported separately per run; OpenCFD concavity failures retained for original/GEOS/hybrid. foam-extend extended determinant check reports all cells in these 2D extrusions, including the independent cfMesh case; not treated as a clean extended pass.

interchangeFix: Preserve signed -1 legacy neighbour sentinels, normalize full nFaces neighbour lists to internal faces, use source declared empty patches, reject lost rotor/housing. Previously invalid zero-flow cfMesh passes excluded and logs preserved.
excluded: cfMesh cases before full-neighbour normalization (zero-flow false passes)
native hybrid direct full-CSV restart rejected before run
conclusions: Original and independently clipped fine annulus defeat both tested SIMPLE implementations, while both coupled implementations converge. This does not isolate one universal cause.
Native SIMPLE also converges on GEOS coarse, preserved hybrid and mature cfMesh meshes; no general native SIMPLE failure is established.
Converged pressure contains local spikes. Hybrid improves global native circle-reference RMS but does not establish pointwise pressure precision.
Analytic boundary-trace verification is a different prescribed-velocity model; it reduces original native pressure bias but leaves discretization error. No mesh-convergence qualification.

consumers.acceptedInputsAndFields: Repeat solves, compare same-discrete fixed points, diagnose pressure/coupling; original raw evidence also in existing failure-inputs and cutcell-cross archives.
consumers.failedCases: Minimal original/fine-GEOS SIMPLE failures and research adapter logs for diagnosis; all raw attempts remain in ignored outputs/annulus-cross.
consumers.rebuildable: Venv, compiler binaries, libraries, Docker image layers and duplicate visualization exports remain local and are not archived as source dependencies.
